The lower parts kit are the moving parts in the lower receiver. Its the magazine catch, bolt release, hammer and trigger with springs and pins, the front and rear captive pins, buffer tube, buffer, recoil spring, stock, and some springs and detents. If you can get a lower receiver with these parts already installed, that makes it a little easier to put the rifle together. If you have all that already, its just putting on the assembled upper receiver and you have a whole gun.
